purpose: Proportionate lifecycle, history-consumption and clean-cost diagnosis after adverse/inconclusive direct79 W4 point estimate; no strength inference
selectionRule: First two scheduled complete games, plies16/40/64/88 if available and nonterminal, deduplicate identical real move prefixes; no result/evaluation filtering. Dependent exploratory trajectories.
settings: CP64 Hash64 ADAPTIVE16 unchanged BOUNDARY2, maxdepth20/max200000 admitted nodes; W1/W4 one observed round each, W1 clean-neutrality replay; W4 clean one warmup and two measured rotated rounds.
limits: 60s per request, outer600s per process, no concurrent matches. Board restoration, legal PV, accounting and drain assertions must pass.
expectedCost: Under60s based on prior fixed-node costs; active diagnostic budget remains about6900s.
limitations: Current control is corrected80 composition, not old79. Fixed-node diagnostics are not game clocks. W4 scheduling varies; final-job counters are not complete request totals; traces observe actual decisions but may affect scheduling. No claim that this explains the competitive result.
